statement: FIFA Statutes 2024 (official): Art. 10 - the Congress decides whether to admit, suspend or expel a member association, solely upon the Council's recommendation; Art. 11.2 - membership is only permitted if an association is currently a member of a confederation; Art. 22(g) - provisional member status is granted by the confederation (upon FIFA's recommendation) to associations applying for membership, entitling them only to take part in the confederation's competitions and conferences, with other rights governed by the confederation's own statutes (the following sentence 'Provisional members may not take ...' is truncated in text extraction; the saved PDF is authoritative).
limitations: 2024 edition; historical statutes not obtained. Institutional structure is treated as stable for policy purposes; see policy_provisional_membership.md.

statement: FIFA's official membership count was 164 before and became 178 only upon the 3 July 1992 Congress admissions ('With the addition of the 14 countries, FIFA now has 178 members'); the Baltic states' provisional membership (granted December 1991) did not increase the official member count before the Congress.
limitations: Count figure from wire reports, not a FIFA publication; used together with AGB5-C001 for the policy determination that provisional membership did not constitute FIFA membership of record.

fifa_association_name: Lietuvos futbolo federacija (LFF); same sequence applies to Estonia and Latvia
statement: The Baltic associations held a provisional status from December 1991 (UEFA: LFF readmitted 9 December 1991; LA Times: 'granted provisional membership in December') and were admitted to FIFA membership at the 3 July 1992 Congress; under the policy determination in this batch, FIFA membership for study purposes starts at the Congress admission.
limitations: Two-step sequence documented by non-FIFA sources; the policy step (provisional status does not count) is a project decision recorded in policy_provisional_membership.md, justified by AGB5-C001/C002.

statement: Congress date anchors used by this batch's assessments: 48th Congress Zurich 3 July 1992 (UPI/LA Times); 49th Congress Chicago 16 June 1994 (AP dispatch); 57th Congress Zurich 30-31 May 2007 (official FIFA Financial Report 2006 title page; admission day candidates 31 May per FA/wire vs 29 May per UEFA page, unresolved).
limitations: All non-FIFA sources except the F&R 2006 title-page excerpt; congress dates are anchors for assessments, not admissions records.

statement: Documented two-step for China PR: a FIFA Executive Committee readmission decision reported at 13 October 1979 and a Congress approval reported at 7 July 1980; under the policy determination (membership starts at the Congress admission act, consistent with Statutes Art. 10 and the 1992 member-count evidence), the study treats 1980-07-07 as the membership start date.
limitations: The 1979/1980 day pair rests on search-excerpt-only mirror evidence from batch02/batch03 (wikiwand; direct pages unobtainable); the policy application to China is a project decision recorded in policy_provisional_membership.md; the 2018 report's affiliation year 1980 is consistent.
